title: To Whom It May Concern Letter / Student Document Request
description: Use this guide when a current or continuing student needs help finding the official UAEU student document request service.
verificationNote: The official service exists in UAEU service navigation, but exact portal labels and document options must be verified by logging into the official UAEU service portal.

steps.title: Open the official service page
steps.instruction: Start from the UAEU service page for enrolled or continuing student documents.

steps.title: Sign in through the official UAEU portal
steps.instruction: Use your UAEU account only on the official portal when the service redirects you to sign in.
steps.note: Do not enter UAEU credentials inside this chatbot.

steps.title: Choose the document request
steps.instruction: Look for the document or certificate type you need, such as a student letter or certificate request.
steps.note: The exact label may differ, so follow the official portal wording.

steps.title: Review details before submitting
steps.instruction: Check your name, student number, destination, language, and delivery method before you submit.
steps.note: If a fee, approval, or processing time appears, follow the official portal value.

steps.title: Save the confirmation
steps.instruction: After submission, save or screenshot the official confirmation number for follow-up.
